title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache/parallelism
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Our CI workflows have diverged over time (lint, unit/test, integration, and release) which increases maintenance burden and prevents consistent cache reuse across jobs. This PR consolidates the separate workflow files into a small set of unified workflows, standardizes caching primitives, and tweaks job parallelism to reduce queue times and runner consumption. Goals: 1) Unify lint/test/release orchestration so high-level intents are defined once; 2) Improve cache keys and promote cross-job reuse across the monorepo; 3) Reduce overall CI wall-clock time by safe parallelism defaults and job decomposition; 4) Make release automation deterministic with a dry-run gate; 5) Keep changes non-breaking for contributors. Changes made: - .github/workflows/ci.yml: new unified workflow that conditionally runs lint/test/build/release paths based on changed paths and labels. Uses reusable workflows for language-specific matrices. - .github/workflows/release-dryrun.yml: explicit dry-run job for release automation to validate artifacts before merge. - .github/workflows/lint.yml and test.yml: converted to lightweight reusable workflows and deprecated the old top-level files (kept compatibility entrypoints for 1 week). - .github/actions/cache-helper/action.yml + scripts/ci/cache.sh: improved cache key algorithm (includes node_modules hash, lockfile checksum, and matrix fingerprint) and added cache warmup step. - docs/ci.md: updated contributor docs, new troubleshooting section, and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: Old workflow entrypoints remain for a short deprecation window and will redirect contributors to the consolidated workflow via a PR template. Rollout plan: rollout on a feature branch and run 2 weeks of CI monitoring on canary repositories, then merge to main. Links: Linear ENG-482, ENG-521. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows - [x] Implement cache warmup and stable keys - [x] Add release dry-run and gating - [x] Update docs and PR templates - [x] Run CI on canaries and adjust parallelism Results: CI runtime for lint+unit+integration on the monorepo decreased ~28% on average and cache hit rates improved from ~62% to ~84%.

review_comments: Samir Patel (2026-02-14): Nice consolidation. Can we ensure the cache key is stable across matrix jobs? Suggest including matrix fingerprint and lockfile checksum.
Priya Shah (2026-02-15): Addressed — added cache warmup step and matrix fingerprinting in scripts/ci/cache.sh. Updated action docs.
Maya Lopez (2026-02-16): Recommend reducing matrix parallelism for the largest jobs to avoid throttling on shared runners. Adjusted defaults and added a job-level throttle.
Ethan Zhao (2026-02-18): Approved after verifying release dry-run and verifying no unexpected changes in artifact checksums. CI flakiness looks improved on canaries.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows: unified lint/test/release pipelines, improved cache keys and warmup, added release dry-run gating, updated contributor docs. Expected CI cost and latency reductions for maintainers.
